verdict.rationale: Chronicle documents attaching scorers to tasks. An LLM judge can be used to assess qualities such as clarity or completeness alongside code checks. Scorers return 0–1 values with configurable pass thresholds, and scorers are versioned and pinned to evaluation runs. Missing for 10: documentation of how the judge itself is configured (custom rubric/prompt, judge model selection), worked examples or SDK details for defining LLM-judge scorers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
